  requires (1 <= x1)
  requires (x1 <= 100)
  requires (1 <= x2)
  requires (x2 <= 100)
  requires (1 <= x3)
  requires (x3 <= 100)
  requires (x1 != x2)
  requires (x1 != x3)
  requires (x2 != x3)
  ensures (result == ((if ((x1 >= x2) and (x1 >= x3)) then x1 else if ((x2 >= x1) and (x2 >= x3)) then x2 else x3) - (if ((x1 <= x2) and (x1 <= x3)) then x1 else if ((x2 <= x1) and (x2 <= x3)) then x2 else x3)))
  ensures (result >= 1)
  ensures (result <= 99)
  effects pure
  example (FindMinimumTotalDistance(0, 0, 0) == 0)
